endorsements.quote: Establishing interdisciplinary teams that include ethicists, data scientists, healthcare professionals, and preferably a patient representative to guide the ethical development and deployment of AI solutions[ 13 ]; and (2) Facilitating regular discussions and workshops to address ethical concerns and integrate diverse perspectives into AI research and development processes.

Implementing ethical review processes specifically tailored to AI projects in healthcare research, akin to traditional human subjects’ research oversight; and (2) Establishing ethics committees or boards with expertise to evaluate AI projects, focusing on the potential risks, benefits, and ethical considerations.
Promoting transparency by publicly sharing information about AI projects, including objectives, methodologies, and ethical considerations[ 15 ].

Monitoring the outcomes of AI applications in healthcare research continuously to identify unforeseen ethical issues or adverse effects; and (2) Implementing mechanisms for ongoing evaluation and adaptation of AI technologies, ensuring they remain aligned with ethical principles and societal values[ 16 ].

Strict protocols that adhere to the relevant laws and regulations such as the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) must be established to protect patient data, respecting privacy, and confidentiality throughout the research process.
AI technologies should be designed with diverse populations in mind, actively working to mitigate biases in datasets and algorithms.

unlisted_practices: Develop educational programs for AI researchers and healthcare professionals on the ethical implications of AI in healthcare.
Include modules on ethical decision-making, bias recognition, and mitigation strategies in AI development curricula.
Involve patients, healthcare providers, ethicists, and policymakers in the development and implementation of AI applications.
Design AI systems to be transparent and provide mechanisms to explain decisions to practitioners and patients.
Collaborate with patients, the public, and stakeholders through consultative and participatory design methods to solicit feedback on AI development and impacts.
Create a feedback loop to integrate lessons learned from AI implementation back into the ethical framework and update the framework regularly.
Work with regulatory bodies to ensure AI policies and guidelines reflect core ethical principles.
